sloka: स्पर्शानिव प्रहारांस्तान् वेदयानो न विव्यथे।ऋषभं तु महावेगं बाहुभ्यां परिषस्वजे ।। ६.६७.२७ ।।
transliteration: sparśāniva prahārāṁstān vedayāno na vivyathe।ṛṣabhaṁ tu mahāvegaṁ bāhubhyāṁ pariṣasvaje ।। 6.67.27 ।।

translations.english: Those Vanaras of exceptional strength attacked gigantic Kumbhakarna on all sides by rocks, trees and by their fists, hands and feet also.
